  PROBLEM: The pattern matches any line starting with `::error::`, `##[error]`, `::warning::` or `##[warning]` followed by `claude`. For example, `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml` lines 526, 1373, 2067 and 2666 print `::error::Claude pool at capacity ...`.
  WHY: The heal fingerprint for those messages changes, so a new lineage opens. `scripts/ai_engine_fallback_report.sh` has more `::warning::Claude capacity wait ...` lines. The effect is a one-time lineage split for rare capacity-pause messages. The reviewer suggests anchoring the regex to the renamed messages.

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:2152 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_ENGINE_LEAD_RE` rewrites every `Claude` that immediately follows an error or warning annotation to `codex`, not just the renamed attempt-loop messages. For example, `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:526` emits `::error::Claude pool at capacity (role RETRO)...`.
  WHY: `error_signature()` passes annotation lines through `normalize_error_line()`, so an unchanged capacity-wait failure gets a different fingerprint and no longer deduplicates against its prior heal lineage.
- TASK_GAP: scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh fallback path and .github/workflows/implement.yml implement retry loop | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  Requirement: "If Claude is unavailable and a run falls back to Codex mid-attempt, the remaining lines for that attempt (and later attempts) say 'Codex'." The PR also says implement attempt lines and failure diagnostics name the engine that ran.
  Expected change site: `scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh` fallback path and `.github/workflows/implement.yml`'s implement retry loop.
  Evidence of absence: On the `HEAL_ROUTE` path, `implement.yml` refreshes the display name from the `claude-implement.unavailable` marker. The heal script switches its local `heal_engine` to `codex` on Claude exit 75 but does not write that marker, so later attempt and failure-diagnostic lines still say `Claude`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:2152, 2161 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4

  WHY: The regex `((?:::error::|##\[error\]|::warning::|##\[warning\]|last_status=)\s*)claude\b` changes the fingerprints of existing error lines, so heal lineages keyed on the original fingerprint do not match and new heal issues are spawned. The new test covers only `claude_pool` with an underscore, which does not match, and not the over-broad `claude ` case.
